svg.title: Movements claimed in Fenton's thread
svg.desc: A world map centred on the Pacific with arrows for the movements Bruce R. Fenton claims: into Oceania about 900,000 years ago, back into Asia and Africa, a maritime expansion from Island Southeast Asia by 40,000 years ago reaching northern Australia, southern Asia, Africa and South America, and later routes to Göbekli Tepe and northwards through the Americas.

g.text: c. 900,000–800,000 years ago: into Oceania, then back into Asia and Africa (his 2017 model)
by 40,000 years ago: a maritime culture of Island Southeast Asia and its claimed reach
after the sea-level rise: symbols carried to Anatolia; the Rainbow Serpent northwards
Arrows and dates are the thread's claims,
drawn by this project. Modern coastlines (Natural Earth).
